🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-09-12 23:00 → 2026-09-13 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **predicate_conformance.v0 merged and hardened same day** — The PIN-RECORD conformance implementation landed, two independent post-merge recomputes surfaced four concrete gaps, and a follow-on hardening PR was open before the window closed. [commit f5a25bd](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/commit/f5a25bd6bbf555c710d63915d4e5092548e3702c)

> **Derivation frozen, disclosure live** — Toshikatsu's derivation reached a freeze commit and the associated GitHub disclosure cleared all checks, readying the pinned materials for the group's agreed post-commit comparison. [tg:tawg:4668]

> **Contribution evaluation draft opened a structural conversation** — A draft separating contribution DAGs from realization records entered active discussion and drew immediate substantive feedback on its core framing. [tg:tawg:4649]

## 🤝 **What moved**

### recompute-kit

_The predicate-conformance direction moved through a complete merge, independent recompute review, and same-day hardening cycle._

- Baby Blue Viper **Shipped** `predicate_conformance.v0` into recompute-kit, implementing the PIN-RECORD precommit, conformance-run, and repair-run flows and giving the group a working executable baseline for conformance checking. [PR #14](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/14)

- Merlini **Reviewed** PR #14 by independently recomputing before approving rather than relying on the description, caught an integrity issue in the process, and kept the recompute-before-approving norm as a practiced reality for the group. [PR #14 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/14#pullrequestreview-5190803963)

- Pavlo **Ran** a post-merge recompute on the merged head and surfaced four concrete issues — including stale test vectors and a canonicalization gap — turning the post-merge step into an actionable hardening agenda. [PR #14 comment](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/14#issuecomment-5653571904)

- Baby Blue Viper **Opened** a follow-on hardening PR immediately after Pavlo's post-merge findings, converting all four review notes into tracked work rather than informal debt. [PR #43](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/43)

- Raul ThoughtProof (@raulj1980) **Named** the value of finding a hole, reproducing it, fixing it, and registering a regression guard as one complete act, sharpening the group's shared expectation for what a meaningful conformance result actually requires. [tg:tawg:4655]

### derivation

_A long-running derivation reached a stable freeze and its disclosure cleared all automated checks._

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Relayed** that Toshikatsu's derivation is now frozen at a specific commit in a private repository, establishing a stable reference point for the group's planned post-commit comparison. [tg:tawg:4661]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Confirmed** the associated disclosure is posted on GitHub with all checks green and the pinned materials are ready for the agreed comparison once Toshikatsu confirms access. [tg:tawg:4668]

### contribution-evaluation

_A new structural framework for thinking about attribution entered active group discussion._

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Shared** a rough draft that separates the contribution DAG — capturing what was contributed and in what structure — from realization records that capture who contributed and how, giving the group a cleaner vocabulary for its attribution and evaluation work. [tg:tawg:4649]

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Engaged** with the draft's core framing, endorsed the DAG-versus-realization-records split as genuinely sharp thinking, and flagged a missing open question about cross-contributor flows, moving the feedback from general approval into specific structural gaps. [tg:tawg:4650]

### ccip-router

_CI reliability improved with a targeted pipeline fix._

- Merlini (@gobross) **Fixed** the ccip-router CI pipeline to use a single publisher, eliminate stale-layer caching, and enforce immutable SHA image tags, removing a category of silent inconsistencies that could affect the group's deployment artifacts. [PR #10](https://github.com/trustless-ai/ccip-router/pull/10)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**

- The contribution evaluation draft's open question on cross-contributor flows could anchor a focused session once the DAG and realization-record model firms up
- The frozen derivation and live disclosure set up the group's post-commit comparison — worth scheduling once Toshikatsu confirms access

### ✅ **TODOs**

- Baby Blue Viper to land the `predicate_conformance.v0` post-merge hardening via PR #43
- Toshikatsu to confirm access to the disclosure repository so the comparison can proceed
- Jimmy Shi to gather feedback on the contribution evaluation draft and surface the key open questions

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** One conformance implementation merged, two reviewers recomputed it independently, four gaps surfaced, all four were acknowledged, and a hardening PR was open — all within the same window. The full loop closed before the day did.
>
> When the group can ship, review, recompute, and queue the fix before the session ends, Trusty barely has time to update the index. Keep the loops tight. ⚡
